{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id counts: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check the unique values of assay_batch
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Patient count with multiple sample_seq: {len(sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1])}')"}
